title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
kidExplanation: Story version: The problem is to find the cells in a matrix where water can flow from both the Pacific Ocean and the Atlantic Ocean. We can solve this using Depth-First Search (DFS) starting from the ocean borders. Each cell that can be reached from both oceans will be added to the final result. (We will slow down and draw it.)
